problem: The v1 Order response field totalCents is renamed to amountCents, and openapi.yaml is edited in place under /v1 (required list and property), with no /v2 and no deprecation period.
impact: Every generated v1 client that reads totalCents gets undefined after deploy; README says a breaking change ships as /v2 next to /v1.

problem: Three new endpoints are not in openapi.yaml: POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel, GET /v1/orders/{id}/refunds and POST /v1/orders/{id}/refunds. The project's contract is spec-first and clients are generated from it.
impact: No generated client can call them, and their request/response shapes and error codes are undocumented.

problem: POST refunds creates a refund (money movement) without the IdempotencyInterceptor / Idempotency-Key that every other creating mutation uses.
impact: A client retry after a timeout records a second refund; the order-total check only caps the sum, so two partial refunds of the same request both succeed.

problem: The refund handler takes @Res() and catches every error itself, answering { error: err.message } instead of letting ApiErrorFilter build the ApiError envelope; unknown errors (e.g. a TypeORM QueryFailedError) send their raw message with status 500.
impact: Clients get an error shape without code/requestId that the spec forbids, and database error text (constraint and column names, SQL fragments) reaches API consumers.

problem: The refund body is an inline type, not a DTO class with class-validator decorators, so the global ValidationPipe validates nothing; validation is hand-rolled in the service and answers 422 (UnprocessableEntityException) instead of the project's 400 for a validation failure.
impact: Malformed input (a non-string reason, extra fields) passes; clients that handle the documented 400 VALIDATION_FAILED get 422 / HTTP_422 instead.

problem: GET refunds returns a bare array, while every other list endpoint returns the { data, meta } envelope.
impact: Clients need a special case for this list, and adding paging metadata later is a breaking change.
